patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I got up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom. Next thing I knew I was on the floor. Nothing hurts; I'm mostly embarrassed that my wife found me there.
clinical.presentationShort: 69yo M - nocturnal syncope while standing to urinate; woke on the floor with no injury, chest pain, palpitations or focal deficit. Now completely back to baseline.
clinical.presentationLong: 69-year-old male with a brief unwitnessed loss of consciousness while standing to urinate during the night, now fully recovered with no injury, chest pain, palpitations, persistent confusion or neurologic deficit.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute -> ECG, orthostatic vitals, glucose and focused syncope assessment; discharge only if evaluation is reassuring
diagnosis.why: The timing is classic for micturition syncope: standing suddenly at night, urinating, then a brief reflex faint with rapid recovery. But at 69, an unwitnessed blackout still needs an ECG and assessment for arrhythmia, bleeding, medication effects and orthostasis before the benign label is earned.
diagnosis.redFlag: Older adult with unwitnessed loss of consciousness - the situational trigger is reassuring, but it does not replace a syncope evaluation.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 69-year-old man in a tidy cardigan over sleep clothes and slippers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting normally and comfortably with both hands loosely folded in his lap
aiImageGeneration.expression: well, alert and mildly sheepish rather than dazed or ill
signs: no bandages, bruises or visible injury
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: completely back to normal after a brief faint
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style with smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines, warm detailed rendering and natural realistic proportions. Match the attached reference image's painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette. Full-body wide shot, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, centered. Show the entire person and entire blue padded clinic chair, including all feet, slippers and chair legs, with generous empty margin on all sides. Subject: a white 69-year-old man in a tidy cardigan over modest sleep clothes and slippers. Pose: sitting normally and comfortably with both hands loosely folded in his lap. Expression: alert, healthy and mildly sheepish, with a small embarrassed half-smile; not dazed, confused, injured or acutely ill. No bruises, bandages, medical equipment, text, logos, shadows, floor plane, watermark or border. Perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background.
